result.summary: The page looks mostly functional and well-structured. One minor content issue was identified.

issues.description: The last item in the 'Popular right now' section shows a '-0%' badge on the pizza restaurant card, which is a nonsensical discount label. A discount of 0% provides no value and looks like a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Ensure discount badges only appear when there is an actual non-zero discount, or fix the data pipeline to avoid displaying '0%' or '-0%' labels.
